final_response: The kernel landed clean on the first try. `output_model_new.py` flattens the 4D tensor A from `(b, i, j, l)` into `(b*i*j, l)`, then runs a tiled GEMM with 64×64 block tiles, 256 threads, and shared-memory double buffering. FP32 accumulation in registers keeps the BF16 inputs numerically sound across the 256-element reduction. The harness reports 5/5 correctness and a ~13× speedup over the reference `torch.einsum`.
